reason: Re-checked 12 Nov 2026 (janmoller.com home, Norwegian): he presents himself as a physician, psychotherapist and health educator working in mental health, stress prevention and coping, and his services are mainly therapy and counselling (individual sessions, parenting and couples guidance, leadership coaching, workplace programmes) framed around health and treatment. Out under the scope rule (mainly therapy); the owner could revisit if a mindfulness-only listing is wanted. A contact form exists at https://janmoller.com/kontakt/.
